0022600140.text: The Nuggets (1-2, 10th in the West) are 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, and are coming off a loss, while the Pelicans (0-3, 14th in the West) have lost three straight and sit 3.5 games back in the Southwest. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise) and Jordan Poole (illness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Denver leads the 2026-27 series 1-0 after its 141-135 win in Denver on October 24, and it also won all three meetings in 2025-26.
